root.page_intro: Kobool service is free. We designed a payment system that will charge about $3 per each match. However, the actual service payment will not start untill we make sure that it is easy for all the members to pay electronically without any hardship. So, until then we are inviting you to enjoy the service totally free.
root.used_current: In order for you and %m% to communicate you and %m% have to spend 2 Kobool Cards. It is recommended that you each of you spend 1 Kobool Card. However, any of you may choose to spend 2 cards if the other person is unable to spend his part.
root.free_buy_form_intro: Send your email address to recieve a free Kobool Card number
root.buy_help: To get free Kobool Card click on the "Get Kobool Card" button.
root.success_free_buy: Your Free Activation number has been created and sent to the email address you provided. Your confirmation number is: %n%. Keep this number to use in case of failure to recieve or use your activation number. Click "Add Credit" and enter the activation number.
root.match_refundable: The Cards you and %m% spent in this match will be refunded to your accounts in case of decline without sending and recieving messages and without decline final message
root.match_none_refundable: The cards you and %m% spent in this match can not be refunded to your accounts because messages were sent and recieved between you and your %m%
root.click2change: click here to change or email your message
root.select_a_message: Select one of the listed messages:
root.success_add: You successfully added 1 Kobool Card to your account. You can spend now this card when needed to contact Kobool Match
root.match_not_paid: You and %m% have not yet spent the required Kobool Cards to contact each others. Click on the Refresh button to check the latest status.
root.match_paid: The required Kobool Cards to contact each others have been spent. Click on Contact button to open the Contact page.
